sv.title: Danmark utvisar Rysslands försvarsattaché
sv.summary: Danmark utvisar Rysslands försvarsattaché, rapporterar danska medier. ”Han ska vara ute inom sju dagar”, säger utrikesminister Lars Løkke Rasmussen (M).

en.title: Denmark expels Russia's defence attaché
en.summary: Denmark is expelling Russia's defence attaché, Danish media report. "He is to be out within seven days", says foreign minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen (M).
